payload.text: Pre-registered sizing rule ('re-size only on a change or if over the cap') ratchets notional down: when equity falls the cap shrinks the position, and it never grows back. Always-long (UB02) exposure fell from 1.0x to 0.39x by 2015 and 0.32x by 2023; slow trials (e.g. V135, median hold 465 days) are affected similarly. Sharpe-based criteria are largely scale-invariant and every DSR is far below 0.95, so the verdict is very unlikely to change, but this is not verified; dollar figures (ledger returns, stress lows) are understated for long holds.
